# Fashio

Fashio is a modern fashion e-commerce website offering clothing, shoes, handbags, and accessories for men and women.

## Website

- [Fashio Home](https://fashio-eight.vercel.app/)
- [Shop](https://fashio-eight.vercel.app/shop)
- [Men Collection](https://fashio-eight.vercel.app/men-collection)
- [Women Collection](https://fashio-eight.vercel.app/women-collection)
- [Contact](https://fashio-eight.vercel.app/contact)

## Products

Fashio provides fashion products for men and women, including clothing, shoes, handbags, and accessories.

## Purpose

This website provides information about Fashio's products, collections, services, and online shopping experience.
